<thought>Using the mass spectrum we determined the neutral molecular mass to be 224.120 Da, corresponding to the formula C₁₆H₁₆O. The ¹H NMR shows a 3 H singlet at 2.23 ppm (aromatic methyl), two 2 H triplets at 2.81 and 2.98 ppm (a –CH₂‑CH₂‑ chain), and nine aromatic protons (7 H at 7.17 ppm and 2 H at 7.90 ppm). This pattern fits a para‑methyl phenyl group attached to a carbonyl, with the carbonyl linked via a –CH₂‑CH₂‑ bridge to a monosubstituted phenyl ring. The SMILES that encodes this structure is **Cc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)CCc2ccccc2**, which is a valid SMILES and matches the derived formula and NMR data.</thought>
<final_answer>Cc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)CCc2ccccc2</final_answer>
